applies_why: This judge text decides how Isaiah 7:14 wording and application are credited after earlier rounds, so it applies the unanswered-witness counting rule.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: the phrase 'counts as an unanswered witness' — two readings weighed: (1) it governs only when a verse is being counted as unanswered, so an answered verse is merely not counted; (2) it requires quoting earlier pressed-round sentences even when noting an answer. I used reading (1).
why: The judge treats the Isaiah 7:14 wording as answered in named rounds and does not count it as an unanswered witness, which is what K-G4 requires.
